fields.description:
Objective

Define, with client input, how a flagged Sign-Up should affect overall Player status — specifically the case where a Player has other valid, completed Sign-Ups. Automating this without a clear rule risks incorrectly flagging a Player with an otherwise valid history.

Why This Matters

Not automated in the POC by design. A documented rule is needed before this becomes build work under the Fraud Flags & Exception Handling epic.

Action Needed

Walk through scenarios with the client and document the agreed rule.

\----------------------------------------

comments.body:
STILL OPEN AND NOW BLOCKING — 2026-07-28 reconciliation.

BUILD-18 (Doc #17) and BUILD-34 (Doc #9.3/#45) settle what fraud does to the SIGN-UP: Fraud Flag + Fraud Review Status, record locked to Reps, Completed records stay Completed, Dismissed restores Previous Status.

Neither says what fraud does to the PLAYER. Player_Status__c carries a "Flagged for Fraud" value with no defined trigger and no defined exit. Open questions:

* Does a fraud-flagged Sign-Up set the Player to Flagged for Fraud automatically, or is that a separate Ops action?

* If a Player has one confirmed-fraud Sign-Up out of many, does the Player status change?

* On Dismissed, does the Player status revert?

BLOCKS: BUILD-34 cannot be built without an answer. Needs Wagertech / Ops.
